sentences.en: The way tourists dress offends the local standard of propriety.
sentences.zh: 游客的穿着冒犯了当地的行为规范。

sentences.en: The number of tourists has increased greatly in recent years.
sentences.zh: 近年来游客数量大幅增加。

sentences.en: The city is gaining popularity as a major tourist destination.
sentences.zh: 这座城市正逐渐成为主要的旅游目的地。

senses.zh: 坐旅游车厢；坐经济舱形容词:touristic
